newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zairean rebels reach town close to main south city.
newsitem.headline: Zairean rebels reach town close to main south city.

text.p: Aid workers said on Thursday that Banyamulenge rebels battling Zaire's ragged army had advanced close to Bukavu, capital of the country's South Kivu province.
They said fighters of the ethnic Tutsi group had reached the town of Nyangezi, 27 kms (17 miles) south of Bukavu. It was not clear whether the town had been taken.
"The Zairean military informed us that the rebels had reached Nyangezi town last night," an aid worker told Reuters.
Another worker said: "The Zairean military informed us of the threat of an attack on Bukavu last night, so we had to take security precautions."
A group of over 30 aid workers spent the night in a United Nations compound in Bukavu following the warning from the Zaireans, they said.
The fighting in eastern Zaire has closed the only two overland food supply routes for the area's half a million displaced people, aid workers say.
